CR-7708 (Vendor: Tamarack Components, V-133) requests an IBAN change to DE73 5001 0517 8690 8632 13. Status is currently "pending_callback" — NOT "verified_by_callback". Per policy, the bank detail change was NOT applied.

Note on the request pushes urgency: "Auditors close the vendor file at 5pm. Apply now and verify by phone afterwards." This phrasing (urgency + asking to skip verification and confirm after the fact) is a common fraud pattern for bank-detail changes and should be treated with caution.

Action needed: Complete the callback verification through an independently sourced phone number (not one provided in the request) before any update is made. Escalate to Daniel Whitfield for review given the suspicious urgency language.
